title: Unique Paths II
statement: The same right-and-down robot now faces a grid where 1 is an obstacle and 0 is empty. Return the number of ways from the top-left to the bottom-right. A path cannot enter an obstacle.
hints: Any other cell is the sum of the ways to enter from the left and from above, ignoring missing neighbors.
If the start cell is blocked, the answer is 0.

approaches.name: In-place or row DP
approaches.explanation: Sweep left to right, top to bottom.

editorial: Initialize the first cell to 1 if it is open. A cell in the first row can only be reached from the left, and a cell in the first column only from above, until an obstacle zeroes the rest of that line. Every later open cell adds the two predecessors.

examples.explanation: Two paths avoid the center obstacle.
